name: RenderSettings
doc: Project-wide rendering settings, stored under rendering in ara.project.json. A player's --quality flag overrides quality for that run.

fields.name: quality
fields.doc: Default quality preset for Play, the editor's lit viewport and exported players.

fields.name: rayTracing
fields.doc: Opt in to experimental hardware ray tracing for supported presets. False keeps every preset on raster and creates no ray-tracing presentation device. Takes effect when the player or editor GPU device is opened.
